pages.body:
⛔ Clean-room review (tier L, 3 reviewers + 1 verifier) — **REQUEST_CHANGES**

CP wiring, Grafana-admin move and oauth2-proxy `allowed_roles` are sound (tests+lean reviewer APPROVE). Blocking (found independently by 2 reviewers, CONFIRMED by verifier):

1. **[blocking]** `tenants/templates/configmap-credentials.yaml` (deleted) — the tenant ConfigMap `plaid-rpc-credentials` becomes an ESO Secret of the same name, but plaid master `plaid/core/utility/kubernetes.py:4348-4351` `_get_rpc_volumes()` hard-codes a non-optional `V1ConfigMapVolumeSource(name="plaid-rpc-credentials")` for rpc-spawned export (:688), workflow (:970/:981), lakehouse-transfer (:2200) Jobs and user CronJobs (:4159); `test_credentials_volume_always_configmap` pins it and `reconcile_user_cronjob_volumes` only repairs `config`. After a tenant syncs this chart and Argo prunes the ConfigMap, every new such pod sticks in ContainerCreating (FailedMount) and persisted user CronJobs fail fleet-wide. Fix: plaid PR first — detect the credentials volume kind from the rpc Deployment (as for `config`) and extend the CronJob reconciler; pin that image before/with this chart.

Non-blocking (being fixed in the same batch):
- `eso.tenantConfig.enabled` gates a Secret that every pod mounts non-optionally — drop the gate (no default-off flags).
- oauth2-proxy: template should own `provider = "keycloak-oidc"` like `scope`, so a content override cannot silently disable `allowed_roles`; C10 scope regex misses single-quoted TOML.
- "C8" vs C10 naming in VENDORED-PATCHES.md / lint.yml.
- No render assertion for the new ExternalSecrets / absence of D1-A keys in the CP Secret.
- Grafana admin rotation must reset each tenant DB admin password (sidecars auth with the Secret → 401 otherwise).
- Not fixed here (filed sc-36237 scope): `profit_store.encrypt_phrase` / `braintree.merchant_id` literals in the credentials template.
- Merge == ci deploy: Vault seeding must precede merge (PR body says so; nothing enforces it).

<!-- self-approve -->

⛔ Clean-room re-review (tier L, opus, focused on eff76055f→f11b67b9d + rebase) — **REQUEST_CHANGES** (ordering precondition only, no code defect)

Blocking: the beta path. Infra RCs keep beta's image pins, and plaid `beta-202610` does not yet contain ebbce9cc78 (#8879). The 7 beta-ref tenants would get the Secret-backed `credentials` volume while old rpc images hard-code the ConfigMap source, so spawned Jobs and user CronJobs would hang in ContainerCreating. Resolution: a plaid beta train to get ebbce9cc78 into beta and its pin bumped on infra beta BEFORE any infra RC that carries this chart. Master alone is safe (rpc:ebbce9c-4967-1 is pinned alongside).

Non-blocking:
- Transient: the tenant ConfigMap is pruned in wave 0 while rpc/keda-workers roll; old pods cache the "configMap" kind, so Jobs spawned in that minutes-long window need a rerun.
- `tenants/templates/grafana/external-secret-grafana-admin.yaml:30` lacked `| default "tenant-clusters"` (fixed in the next commit).
- The Grafana admin password moved unrotated (E9 rotation planned); dead `apps.cp_rest.credentials.*` literals remain in plaid-tenant-applications overlays (remove + rotate after the prod tag).

Verified: rebase range-diff all `=`; master pins intact; every remoteRef key/property matches Vault; ESO policies read all paths; prod-blue overlay renders C12; 38/38 tenants get one keycloak-oidc provider.

<!-- self-approve -->
